mark_scheme.criterion: States: energy that an object has because of its motion.

hints: Recall the controlled definition of kinetic energy from the Cambridge 9702 syllabus.
State the exact phrasing: energy that an object has because of its motion.
solution: Kinetic energy is the energy that an object has because of its motion.
teacher_walkthrough: Insist on the exact Cambridge definition: energy that an object has because of its motion.
Remind students that mentioning motion is essential to secure mark B1.
